label: DPDP Readiness Assessment
description: A guided gap assessment against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — answer plainly, and Jethur scores how ready you are section by section, then turns every gap into a fix you can act on.
emptyTitle: You haven't run a readiness assessment yet
emptyDescription: {count} questions, about 20 minutes, scored against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. You get a readiness score and a section-by-section gap report.
baselineCaption: JDP-GAP · BASELINE FOR THE DASHBOARD SCORE
gapsDescription: {count} finding(s) — owned by the module that fixes each one.
wizardGenerating: Scoring your answers against the Act…
toastScopeRequired: Answer the four scope questions first — they decide which sections apply to you
toastSavedProgress: Saved — {answered} of {total} answered. Pick up where you left off any time.
demoBarBody: Fill all {count} answers with a sample set so you can review the report without working through the questionnaire.
demoFilledToast: Sample answers filled — {count} of {count} answered. Page through, change anything, then generate.
profileIntro: Six answers that set the scope. Everything after this is scored — this step only decides which parts of the Act apply to you.
fieldSectorHint: shapes the sectoral rules we flag
fieldRecordsHeldHint: how many data principals you hold data on
gateKidsLabel: Do you knowingly collect personal data of anyone under 18?
gateKidsHint: Gates the s.9 children's obligations — the second-highest penalty head in the Act.
gateProcLabel: Does any third party process personal data on your behalf?
gateProcHint: Payroll, cloud, CRM, marketing, support vendors, agencies. Gates s.8(2) processor contracts.
gateXbtLabel: Does any personal data leave India?
gateXbtHint: Cloud regions outside India, offshore vendors, group companies, support access from abroad. Gates s.16.
gateSensLabel: Do you process financial, health or biometric data?
gateSensHint: Not a separate category under the DPDP Act, but it raises risk.
scopeSummaryCount: {count} questions apply to you out of {total}
scopeSummaryAllInScope: every domain of the Act is in scope for your answers so far.
scopeSummaryExcluded: — {domains} marked not applicable and excluded from the score.
scopeSummaryUnsureNote: "Not sure" keeps a domain in scope — you cannot rule out an obligation you have not checked.
sdfNoteBody: — {reasons}. The Central Government notifies an SDF under s.10(1) on exactly these factors. If you are notified, s.10(2) adds an India-based DPO, an independent data auditor, and periodic DPIAs and audits.
questionNotePlaceholder: Evidence, system name, or what is missing — carried into the gap report.
domainNotApplicableNote: Marked not applicable from your scope answers — {count} questions excluded from the score. Change it in step 1 if that is wrong.
